gbm_population_evidence.quote: AXL Inhibitor BGB324 in Treating Participants With Recurrent Glioblastoma Undergoing Surgery
Must have histologically confirmed glioblastoma (GBM) that is progressive or recurrent following radiation therapy +/- chemotherapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: AXL inhibitor BGB324 may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Must have histologically confirmed glioblastoma (GBM) that is progressive or recurrent following radiation therapy +/- chemotherapy.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Proportion of patients who achieve a drug concentration at >= 1.0 uM level in contrast enhancing tumor tissue
II. Determine the BGB324 concentration in tissue resected from a contrast non-enhancing region of the tumor.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: I. Determine AXL expression, phosphorylation state (AXL phosphospecific antibody if AXL is inhibited), and circulating soluble AXL levels.
Change in AXL expression level (ng/mL) from baseline (before intervention) to post-intervention.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] BGB 324 (before surgery) (other names: AXL Inhibitor BGB324, Bemcentinib): Given by mouth either BEFORE therapeutic conventional surgery
[DRUG] BGB 324 (after surgery) (other names: AXL Inhibitor BGB324, Bemcentinib): Given by mouth either AFTER therapeutic conventional surgery

coder_notes: Registered phase EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Bemcentinib is registered as two interventions (before / after surgery) differing only in timing relative to surgery; coded as one agent row covering both arms. Gliosarcoma also eligible; still gbm_only. Plain 'glioblastoma' without IDH/WHO reference, so cns5_terminology unclear.
